name: uri-ipv6-literal-no-zone-host-invalid
description: permittedSubtrees uniformResourceIdentifier is 'example.com'. The leaf's URI SAN is 'foo://[1234:5678:90ab::1]/path' — the host is a bracketed IPv6 literal. Per RFC 3986 IP-literal in a URI host is syntactically valid but for X.509 name-constraint purposes the URI must carry a DNS-shaped host; iPAddress is a separate GeneralName type. A validator that strips the brackets and tries to suffix-match against 'example.com' will fail by length, but the cert is malformed against the URI constraint regardless.
notes: Companion to uri-ipv6-zone-host-invalid (IPv6 literal + zone identifier) and uri-ip-host-invalid (dotted-decimal IPv4). This case isolates the plain bracketed IPv6 form.
